files.README.md:
# lumen CRM sync worker

Syncs CRM contacts into `warehouse.contacts` for downstream reports.

Run:

```sh
go build -o bin/worker ./cmd/worker
./bin/worker
```

Configure via environment (`CRM_BASE_URL`, `CRM_CLIENT_ID`,
`CRM_CLIENT_SECRET`, `DATABASE_URL`).

Schedule with `deploy/lumen-sync.timer` (every 10 minutes).

Test:

```sh
go test ./...
go vet ./...
```
files.deploy/lumen-sync.service:
[Unit]
Description=lumen CRM sync worker
After=network.target postgresql.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/lumen-sync-worker
EnvironmentFile=/etc/lumen-sync/env

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
files.deploy/lumen-sync.timer:
[Unit]
Description=Run lumen CRM sync every 10 minutes

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*:0/10
Persistent=true
Unit=lumen-sync.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

files.migrations/002_deleted_at.sql:
ALTER TABLE warehouse.contacts
	ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL;
files.migrations/003_split_phone.sql:
ALTER TABLE warehouse.contacts
	ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS country_code TEXT NULL,
	ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS number TEXT NULL;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW warehouse.v_contacts_with_phone AS
SELECT
	crm_id,
	email,
	name,
	updated_at,
	deleted_at,
	TRIM(COALESCE(country_code, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(number, '')) AS phone,
	country_code,
	number
FROM warehouse.contacts;
